claims: The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special premieres on Tuesday, March 24, 2026.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special premieres at 3 a.m. ET / 12 a.m. PT.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special premieres on Disney+ and Hulu.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special features a sit-down interview with Miley Cyrus hosted by Alex Cooper.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special features appearances by Billy Ray and Tish Cyrus to celebrate the 20th anniversary of the show's 2006 premiere.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special features never-before-seen archival footage.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special features recreated sets.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special will be available around 6 p.m. AEDT on March 24.
The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special was filmed in front of a live studio audience.
The Hannah Montana series originally aired from 2006 to 2011.
